{{Quote|Toss my armor&mdash;my ''beskar'gam''? Never! Better to die standing on my feet, killing my enemies!|Vevec|<ref name="RoguesEnd" />}}
'''Vevec''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]], and [[Parent/Legends|father]] of [[Tes Vevec]]. An experienced fighter, Vevec was a loyal supporter of [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] [[Chernan Ordo]], whom he followed to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Botajef/Legends|Botajef]] in [[127 ABY]] to [[Battle of Botajef|engage]] the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] of [[Roan Fel]]'s [[Fel Empire|Galactic Empire]]. During the battle, Ordo was [[Death/Legends|slain]] and the traitorous soldier [[Yaga Auchs]] usurped the title of ''Mand'alor''. Auchs issued a retreat, and pulled the Mandalorian [[Mandalorian Supercommando|supercommandos]] off world, abandoning Vevec and his former son-in-law, [[Hondo Karr]]. When Karr revealed Auchs' betrayal to Vevec and his plan to escape death at the [[Limb/Legends|hands]] of the overwhelming Imperial forces by donning [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|the armor]] of fallen [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], Vevec understood the importance of exposing Auchs but refused to discard his [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] to avoid death. Instead, realizing the likelihood that the [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] would not believe they were Imperial, Vevec chose to aid Karr in establishing his new identity by pretending to attack him in his acquired trooper armor within view of the approaching Imperials. Vevec was subsequently [[Blaster/Legends|shot]] by a [[Vax Potorr|nearby stormtrooper]] who saw only a Mandalorian attacking a downed ally, and because of Vevec's actions, Karr was welcomed into the Imperial [[Squad/Legends|unit]], [[Joker Squad]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Vevec. What's our situation?''"<br />"''Down a black hole. Mandalore's dead and we're overrun. Yaga Auchs got most of the troops off-planet, but you and I are stuck here with all Imps in the galaxy coming down on us.|[[Hondo Karr]] and Vevec|<ref name="RoguesEnd" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]], Vevec was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance's]] [[Politics/Legends|political]] dominance in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="RoguesEnd" /> At the age of thirteen, Vevec completed the ''[[verd'goten]]'', the traditional rite of passage among Mandalorians that marked him as an adult in their culture.<ref name="TMPaC">{{InsiderCite|86|The Mandalorians: People and Culture}}</ref> As an adult, Vevec was a trained [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]], and was the [[Parent/Legends|father]] of at least one [[Youngling/Legends|child]], a daughter by the name of [[Tes Vevec]].<ref name="RoguesEnd" />

[[File:Vevec_and_Karr.jpg|thumb|left|225px|Vevec speaking with [[Hondo Karr]] on [[Botajef/Legends|Botajef]]]]
In the year [[127 ABY]], the first year of the [[Sith–Imperial War|war]] between the [[Fel Empire]] and the Galactic Alliance, Vevec joined with several other Mandalorian [[Mandalorian Supercommando|supercommandos]] to follow the current [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']], [[Chernan Ordo]], on a job they had been hired for by the Galactic Alliance. Tasked with defending the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Botajef/Legends|Botajef]] from the attacking [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] until the Galactic Alliance [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] arrived, Vevec and his Mandalorian comrades attempted to hold the line against overwhelming numbers of Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and [[Walker/Legends|walkers]]. The already difficult [[Battle of Botajef|battle]] took a turn for the worst when ''Mand'alor'' Ordo was [[Death/Legends|killed]], and with the Imperials overrunning the Mandalorian position, the soldier [[Yaga Auchs]] ordered a retreat, pulling the Mandalorian forces off of Botajef. Vevec was left behind in the chaos, though he came upon the unconscious [[Hondo Karr]], Vevec's former son-in-law who had been previously [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to Vevec's daughter, Tes. Once Karr had been roused and informed of their dire situation, Karr revealed that Yaga Auchs was a traitor, responsible for the Mandalorians' earlier loss of [[Holocomm/Legends|communications]]. He then suggested donning [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|the armor]] of fallen stormtroopers in place of their [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] in order to avoid being killed and allow them to escape. Vevec refused, and while Karr was busy putting on [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]], he realized that the Imperials would be too suspicious to believe that they were loyal stormtroopers. Vevec instead chose to sacrifice himself in order to establish faith in Karr's cover, pretending to attack his ally in front of the approaching enemy soldiers. A [[Vax Potorr|nearby trooper]] saw the scene and believed the ruse to be genuine, opening fire on Vevec. Stuck by a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolt in the [[Throat/Legends|throat]], Vevec was killed, his final act ensuring that Karr was accepted as a soldier of the Empire, taken into the Imperial [[Squad/Legends|unit]], [[Joker Squad]].<ref name="RoguesEnd" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|No one's going to believe you, Karr, including the Imps. So we ''make'' them believe it.''"<br />"''Wha&mdash;?!''"<br />"''The Imps are coming now. Survive. Get the job done.''"<br />"Vevec!|Vevec's final words with Hondo Karr before his death|<ref name="RoguesEnd" />}}
Vevec was a courageous soldier, choosing to carry on firing at the overwhelming Imperial forces on Botajef after the remainder of the Mandalorian [[Troop/Legends|troops]] had retreated off world. He was also a proud man, who disliked the idea of shedding his Mandalorian armor and masquerading as the enemy in order to avoid a fight.<ref name="RoguesEnd" /> Like most Mandalorians,<ref name="TMPaC" /> Vevec held a strong distaste for corpse-robbers, and was willing to risk his life in order to protect and help those he cared for.<ref name="RoguesEnd" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|A warrior's more than his armor, Vevec! You know that!|Hondo Karr|<ref name="RoguesEnd" />}}
Vevec wore Mandalorian armor that was primarily [[Color/Legends|green]],<ref name="RoguesEnd" /> the traditional Mandalorian [[Color/Legends|color]] associated with a sense of duty,<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref> and a popular color choice among Mandalorians for their armor.<ref name="TMPaC" /> Several plates, including those on Vevec's shoulders and his [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlets]] were decorated in [[purple]], and purple accents adorned his helmet around it's T-shaped visor. During the battle on Botajef, Vevec wielded a long-barreled [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] with attached [[Targeting scope|optics]].<ref name="RoguesEnd" />

==Behind the scenes==
The character of Vevec first appeared in the [[Legacy (2006) 41|forty-first issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series, titled ''Rogue's End''. Appearing in a flashback explaining Hondo Karr's departure from the Mandalorians, during which he was drawn by [[Kajo Baldisimo]], Vevec's death is the catalyst responsible for the issue's second storyline featuring his daughter's mistaken attempt at revenge on Karr. Referred to only as "Vevec" throughout the issue,<ref name="RoguesEnd" /> the layout of his daughter's name as Tes Vevec reveals that this is his clan name, rather than his given name.
